links.outcome: Readability, understandability and actionability of AI-generated lymphedema education material
links.effect: Turkish readability index 67.3 ('easily understandable'); PEMAT understandability 92.10 ± 9.03; actionability 81.60 ± 18.47; Global Quality Scale 4.10 ± 0.87.
links.quote: It was determined that the Patient Education Materials Evaluation Tool understandability score average was 92.10 ± 9.03, and the actionability score average was 81.60 ± 18.47.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the understandability, actionability, and readability of patient education materials generated by ChatGPT-4 using expert review and standard readability metrics, but it does not compare outcomes with vs without a specific deployment safeguard/practice.
